title: Viewer UI refresh build stream: Build/DAG sub-tab, filters, inspector and later tab deltas (US-204, US-205, US-18002 and successor USs)
summary: Single FBS owning the Build/DAG sub-tab acceptance criteria (AC-204-1..7, US-204) that land as the viewer UI refresh PR 6, the ID lookup acceptance criteria (AC-205-1..8, US-205) that land as PR 7, the Readiness PO redesign acceptance criteria (AC-18002-1..3, US-18002) that land as PR 8, plus the successor acceptance criteria the same build stream picks up in PR 9. The stream delivers one chain-first tab delta per PR: DAG (PR 6), ID lookup (PR 7), Readiness PO redesign (PR 8), and the shared chrome and release prep (PR 9). This FBS stays `inProgress` for the length of the stream so the AC-ownership check on origin/main is green between PRs; successor PRs extend the `acIds` list under this file as their new USs land.
approach: Build the DAG sub-tab (PR 6) under src/view/build-dag.js with buildDagLayout, renderBuildDag, renderDagInspector and buildDagInspectorPayload; wire html-page.js's renderBuildPanel to call the new renderer in place of the PR 5 placeholder; add wireBuildDag in page-init.js for click-to-highlight, filters, inspector fill from the data-* attribute payload and `#tab=build&sub=dag&entity=` deep links. Inspector payload rides on a `data-rcf-dag-inspector-data` attribute on the inspector shell per the PR 1 contract (no inline <script> body). `currentDagHashExtras` keeps Specs filter keys unknown on the DAG sub-tab so the decision 11 preservation contract holds. applyBuildHash auto-presses Show-unconnected on restoring an unconnected FBS. PR 7 to PR 9 extend the renderer, add their own sub-tab, filter and inspector pieces and append the new ACs to this FBS's `acIds` array; this file is the single owner of the AC coverage for the whole stream so the dogfood tree's `every AC covered by at least one FBS` check stays green at every merge.

notes: Single FBS for the whole viewer UI refresh build stream (ruling 2026-10-02): keeping one FBS avoids a sprawl of near-duplicate FBS entries for the same renderer family. PRs 7 to 9 extended the acIds list under this file as AC-205-*, AC-18002-* and AC-206-* arrived. Status stays `inProgress` after PR 9 lands because every TC on this stream's TS docs is still `pending` (not yet flipped to `passing`); flip to `verified` is a separate housekeeping pass once each TC's status is advanced to `passing` against the green suite.
